payload.text: **RESUME HERE -- 2026-09-17 night, FOURTH fold, written AFTER hv's compact at 21:31Z, replacing doing 57 which asserted something I have since proved false.** ic has NO assigned work outstanding and has asked vc for the next one; do not start anything unasked. **THE CORRECTION FIRST, BECAUSE IT IS THE REASON THIS FOLD EXISTS:** doing 57 said `build release` commits, tags and pushes in one run so that "there is no window after the tag by any sequencing". THAT IS WRONG, and I found it by checking my own source work after warning cc not to lean on it. There IS a window: the push sits behind a human confirmation reading /dev/tty, and declining it exits 2 with the tag ALREADY CREATED LOCALLY -- the driver says so itself, `user aborted before push -- tag <TAG> exists locally; re-run when ready`. What makes the conclusion survive anyway is that the window is a TRAP rather than an opportunity: commit the regeneration into it and the re-run finds the tag pointing at a different sha from the new HEAD and ABORTS rather than force-moving it (`refusing to force-move`), so every route that regenerates after the tag ends in a refusal or in a wrong tag, and shipping the wrong tag is exactly what v3.0.3 did. The regeneration is therefore committed BEFORE the driver runs, which is the page's actual load-bearing claim and is now correctly argued. I had read grep hits and not control flow; every line number I cited was correct and the conclusion was wrong anyway. Landed as a forward correction at `0014f1848` per decision 7, never a rewrite; vc corrected the same overstatement in `intent/wip.md` at `04cd00b47`. **THE RELEASE-DOC WORK IS COMPLETE AND CLOSED OUT:** `intent/docs/releasing.md` plus the CLAUDE.md index pointer landed at `8afcca8d6` on vc's ruling and were corrected at `0014f1848`. **THE BASELINE IS NO LONGER OPEN** -- hv ruled it in decision 25 (2026-09-17 21:16Z, verbatim "3: Tag"): the `docs/reference` baseline is the PREVIOUS RELEASE TAG, and it is written into the page as a COMMAND, `git describe --abbrev=0`, not as a sentence, because a command cannot drift with anyone's reading. The v3.0.2 precedent (tagged, GitHub release created, artefacts never published) is kept in the page as the case hv ruled with in view; it does not bite 3.1.0, whose previous tag is v3.0.3. The staleness-check proposal -- that the cut REFUSE a stale docs/reference at preflight rather than a page asking someone to remember -- is re-banked at `5b513471c` saying its one dependency is DISCHARGED by decision 25 while remaining UNBUILT: hv removed the reason it could not be built, not the decision to build it, and that decision is hv's alone. **0441 IS FINISHED END TO END, unchanged from doing 57:** code `c649596ef`, close `98c580d12`, docs/reference `d21550ae5`, and the behavioural proof is run-d3, ACCEPTED by vc at the scope claimed and no wider -- d2 read WARNINGS 1 with a closing doctor of 1 finding (residue: view-skew), d3 read WARNINGS 0 with a closing doctor of 0, on identical opening and closing populations, with the window TESTED rather than assumed. The run record is banked at `refs/bank/ic/0441/d3.md` with the asymmetry vc corrected me on (zero `disk.sync_from_disk` is the fix's PREDICTED observation, not an absence of evidence) and the readings that must not be cited (store-vs-canon byte equality read EQUAL in both runs, d2 included). The hardened instrument is `refs/bank/ic/0441/verify.sh` -- it pins realpath, sha256 and mtime of the binary at BOTH ends and refuses the verdict if they differ -- and the unhardened script that actually produced d3 is preserved beside it at `verify-as-run-d3.sh` so the run's provenance survived the re-bank. **MUST NOT: do not restate "the driver is atomic" or "there is no window after the tag" in any form -- read `intent/docs/releasing.md` at HEAD, which is right, in preference to any summary of it including this one.** Do not build the staleness check without hv's word. Do not write the CLAUDE.md pointer into `lib/templates/llm/_CLAUDE.md` -- the template has no such section, and that path is inside DIRT_SCOPE, so writing it there would mark the installed pair as carrying unbuilt changes for ALL FOUR nodes while the rendered file's `user:start`/`user:end` region is what actually preserves the entry. Do not touch `wt-0441` or its target dir; they stay until the close-out on vc's ruling. Do not take the lean-out of `wip.md` and `restart.md` that hv called for post-bounce: that is a globalfold and vc's pen. NO RELEASE, NO PUSH; never `--no-confirm`; never `intent fc`.
